type-system.twistDescription: Heading weights +300 throughout (3xl/2xl: 400→700, xl–xs: 500→800, 2xs–3xs: 600→900); letter-spacing unified to -0.03em on all headings for maximum noir compression

motion-system.twistDescription: All durations ×0.5 for staccato noir pacing (0.1→0.05s, 0.2→0.1s, 0.4→0.2s, 2.1→1.05s); easing cubic-bezier(0.55,0,1,0.45) — aggressive deceleration; steps(1) preserved on dot-grid animation

grid-system.twistDescription: Container set to 100vw, asymmetric padding 80px left / 20px right — full-bleed left-wall layout, content bleeds off right edge like a crime scene photograph

spacing-system.twistDescription: All spacing values compressed to ×0.6 for claustrophobic noir interior — tight rooms, narrow margins

interaction-states.twistDescription: Hover transitions snapped to 0.1s with noir deceleration easing — response is immediate, almost violent. Focus ring amplified: 3px + 2px offset, accent pink-red #fd356e

nav-system.twistDescription: logoPosition changed to center; height clamped to 32px (source 21.1px was below usable threshold after -10px twist). Font fixed from Space Grotesk to Inter (Check C).
nav-system.fixes: fontFamily changed from proprietary 'Space Grotesk' to 'Inter' per Check C consistency fix

concept-summary.twistDescription: Full noir emotional register — single-source lighting, venetian blind geometry, hard editorial cuts between sections. Video brief: venetian blind light shafts (hero), rain on dark window (atmospheric), hands under bare bulb (product detail)
